senses.gloss: (Targ. Y., O. usu. עֲרַע q. v.), Pa. אָרַע, אַרַע same.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 23:2">Targ. Y. Lev. XXIII, 2</cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 10:2">Targ. O. Num. X, 2</cite> <he>לעָרָעָה</he> ed. Berl. (oth. ed. <he>לאַרְעָא</he>); (Targ. Y. <he>לעָרָעָא</he>, <he>לעַרְעָא</he>!). [<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 23:4">Targ. Y. Lev. XXIII, 4</cite> <he>דִּי יִתְרְעוּן</he>, corr. <he>די תְאַרְעוּן</he>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 23:21">Ib. 21</cite>, a gloss <he>חיין וקיימין הי בזמן</he> ref. to the festive benediction <he>שהחייני וקימנו וכ׳</he>.]—Denom. <cite ref="M00068"><he>מְאַרְעָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="M02182"><he>מְעַרְעָא</he></cite>.
